admin_content: Welcome to the Spain Work Experience portal. Please check all sections carefully before departure.
itinerary_subtitle: Your complete schedule for the Spain work experience trip
itinerary_duration: Duration: 4 weeks (Monday to Friday work placements)
itinerary_weekends: Weekend Activities: Cultural trips to Seville, Cádiz, and local experiences
itinerary_note: ⏰ Note: All times are in Spanish local time (CEST)
note1_text: Being on time is essential for work placements and group activities.
itinerary_download_text: Download a printable version of the itinerary for your reference:
accommodation_intro: During your stay in Spain, you will be living in shared accommodation. This section explains what to expect and how to live respectfully with others.
accommodation_overview_list:
• Shared apartments
  • Students will share bedrooms and communal spaces
  • Basic cooking facilities will be provided
  • Staff accommodation will be nearby
accommodation_respect_list:
• Respect others’ space, belongings, and routines
  • Keep noise to a minimum, especially at night
  • Share cleaning responsibilities
  • Resolve disagreements calmly and respectfully
accommodation_rules_list:
• No visitors allowed in accommodation
  • No alcohol or illegal substances
  • Curfew rules apply every evening
  • Rooms must be kept clean and tidy
accommodation_food_list:
• A weekly food allowance will be provided
  • Students are responsible for buying and preparing meals
  • Supermarkets and local shops are within walking distance
  • Halal food options are available in nearby areas
accommodation_budget_text: Managing your money responsibly is an important part of the experience.
accommodation_budget_list:
• Plan meals to avoid overspending
  • Keep track of daily spending
  • Save money for trips and activities
accommodation_location_text: Lebrija is a traditional Spanish town with local shops, cafés, and services. Students are expected to behave respectfully within the community at all times.
culture_intro: Understanding Spanish culture will help you settle in quickly, behave respectfully, and make the most of your work placement experience.
culture_spain_list:
• Capital city: Madrid
  • Official language: Spanish (Castilian)
  • Currency: Euro (€)
  • Climate: Hot summers, mild winters
culture_local_text: Lebrija is a traditional Spanish town in southern Spain. Life is relaxed, community-focused, and strongly influenced by local customs.
culture_local_list:
• Shops may close during the afternoon (siesta)
  • Sundays are generally quiet
  • People value politeness and respect
culture_customs_list:
• Greet people politely when entering shops or workplaces
  • Punctuality at work is expected
  • Dress modestly when in public spaces
  • Respect local traditions and ways of life
culture_laws_list:
• Drinking alcohol is only permitted for those aged 18+
  • Street drinking is not allowed
  • Public nudity is illegal
  • Failure to follow local laws may result in police involvement
culture_phrases_list:
• Hola – Hello
  • Por favor – Please
  • Gracias – Thank you
  • Buenos días – Good morning
  • ¿Hablas inglés? – Do you speak English?
culture_body_text: Hand gestures are commonly used in Spain. Be aware that gestures may have different meanings than in the UK.
flight_intro: This section provides essential information for travel to and from Spain. Please read carefully to ensure a smooth journey.
flight_meeting_location: Location: McDonald’s, Meridian Business Park, Leicester, LE19 1WZ
flight_meeting_info: A coach transfer to the airport will be provided. Students must arrive on time and remain with the group.
flight_cabin_list:
• Maximum size: 40 × 20 × 25 cm
  • Must fit under the seat
  • No liquids over 100ml
  • Laptops and valuables must be in hand luggage
flight_checked_list:
• 20kg maximum weight
  • Clothing and toiletries only
  • Bags will be checked in at the airport
flight_rules_list:
• Follow staff instructions at all times
  • Keep passport secure
  • No alcohol or inappropriate behaviour
  • Remain with the group during travel
flight_return_text: Return travel details will be confirmed during the placement.
work_intro: Your work placement is the main purpose of the Spain international experience. This section explains what is expected of you in the workplace.
work_overview_list:
• Students will attend placement Monday to Friday
  • Typical working hours will be confirmed locally
  • Placements relate to your course area
  • Supervisors will support you during work hours
work_expectations_list:
• Arrive on time every day
  • Wear appropriate clothing and PPE if required
  • Show respect to supervisors, staff, and customers
  • Follow health and safety instructions
  • Use mobile phones only during breaks
work_comm_text: English may not be widely spoken in the workplace. Do your best to use basic Spanish phrases.
work_comm_list:
• Be patient and polite
  • Ask for clarification if unsure
  • Use gestures carefully and respectfully
work_food_list:
• Bring food or money for lunch each day
  • Follow local break schedules
  • Drink plenty of water
work_prof_text: This placement represents Leicester College. Your behaviour reflects both yourself and the college.
work_prof_list:
• Be polite, motivated, and reliable
  • Take pride in your work
  • Report any concerns to staff immediately
